name: wechat-blocks
description: 智能消方块 - 3D block elimination prototype for a WeChat Mini Game.

scripts.build:wechat: webpack --config webpack.config.cjs --mode production --env wechat && node scripts/wechat-validate-build.cjs
scripts.wechat:fortify: npm run build:wechat && node scripts/wechat-ci.cjs fortify
scripts.wechat:preview: npm run build:wechat && node scripts/wechat-ci.cjs preview
scripts.wechat:upload: npm run build:wechat && node scripts/wechat-ci.cjs upload
